skill.summary: Master supplier negotiation tactics for Shopify store owners to reduce COGS, improve terms, and build better supplier relationships. Triggers: supplier negot...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Supplier negotiation playbook for Shopify merchants.

- Develops negotiation strategies and scripts to reduce product costs and improve supplier terms.
- Includes frameworks for cost reduction, MOQ negotiation, and payment terms optimization.
- Offers templates for supplier communication (email/call scripts).
- Focuses on building long-term, reliable supplier partnerships.
- Addresses quality assurance and compliance negotiation with suppliers.
